title: [W] Ore Variants
description: Adds ore variants for Sulfur, Cinnabar, Tuff and more, creating a richer and more diverse mining experience.
body:
# Ore Variants

Bring more variety to Minecraft's underground generation with additional variants of vanilla ores.

From Andesite and Granite to Tuff and other stone types, ores can now appear beyond Stone and Deepslate, creating a more diverse and natural underground experience.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━・ ✦ ・━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ⮚ Features

- Ore variants for Granite, Andesite, Tuff, Sulfur, Cinnabar, Diorite, Basalt, and Blackstone
- Vanilla-friendly world generation
